findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 describes BWXT as supplier of precision naval nuclear components, reactors and fuel to the DOE/NNSA Naval Nuclear Propulsion Program (the customer relationship) and as supplier of proprietary and sole-source valves, manifolds and fittings; no second-source or in-house program disclosed in the filing excerpt or searches.
findings.excerpt: Through this segment, we engineer, design and manufacture precision naval nuclear components, reactors and nuclear fuel for the U.S. Department of Energy ("DOE")/National Nuclear Security Administration's ("NNSA") Naval Nuclear Propulsion Program and we have over 100 years of experience in supplying components for defense applications.

note: Two searches found no disclosed second-source or in-house plan by the U.S. Government/Navy for BWXT naval components. Search summaries (not verbatim) show U.S. Government ~68% of FY2025 revenue; 10-K notes reliance on single-source suppliers (supply side, not customer side). 線索 1 條，程式核實 0 條
